title: SIPP care/work measures retain distinct child-presence and reference-parent universes
source_unit: SIPP person record by reference month, stratified by household members under 18 recode, using final person and Fay-BRR replicate weights

observations.period: 2024 reference year; no household members under 18

denominator.unit: positive-final-person-weight selected person-record/month rows; each measure has its own child-presence and conditional universe

reported_time_lost_from_work_due_to_chil.unit: percent; SE 0 pp; 95% CI 0–0; 28 valid records

observations.method: Official child-presence status flag and child-care status flags/universes; WPFINWGT full estimate and 240 Fay-BRR replicate weights with G=240 and perturbation factor 0.5.
observations.uncertainty: This subgroup is sparse and the intervals are very wide. The presence of valid care records despite no under-18 household member is retained as a universe/documentation issue requiring audit.
observations.subgroup: RHNUMU18 recode children_0; household fields repeated on person records.
observations.counterinterpretation: The child-presence grouping is not itself the child-care universe; reference-parent, fall-reference-year, and household-member definitions may differ. Do not interpret this as ordinary child-care prevalence without a codebook audit.

observations.period: 2024 reference year; one or more household members under 18

denominator.unit: positive-final-person-weight selected person-record/month rows; each measure has its own child-presence and conditional universe

observations.method: Same official-universe and Fay-BRR method as the no-under-18 subgroup.
observations.uncertainty: Intervals are design-based approximations; all measures retain their own reference-parent and conditional universes.
observations.subgroup: RHNUMU18 recode children_1plus; household members under 18 present.
observations.counterinterpretation: Presence of a household member under 18 does not identify the reference parent, care recipient, child age, paid-care arrangement, or work schedule.

related_sources.claim: Official child-presence recode, reference-parent child-care universes, and status flags.

boundary: This is a person-weighted, design-based child-presence comparison. The child-presence and child-care universes are not interchangeable; the sparse no-under-18 cells require a field-level audit. No household prevalence, causal effect, time substitution, recovery, trust, or political action is established.
